title: GodotAgentAction
description: Schema for structured actions taken by the Godot Local AI Agent on a Godot project.

thought.description: Reasoning explaining why this specific action was chosen.

action_type.description: The type of action to perform on the Godot application or project.

parameters.description: Parameters specific to the selected action_type.

file_path.description: Relative file path inside the Godot project (e.g., 'scripts/player.gd' or 'scenes/main.tscn').

root_node_name.description: Name for the root node of the scene (e.g., 'Player' or 'MainLevel').

root_node_type.description: Godot engine node type for the root node (e.g., 'Node2D', 'CharacterBody2D', 'Control').

content.description: Complete GDScript code or TSCN scene text to write.

script_path.description: Optional script path to attach to the scene (e.g., 'res://scripts/player.gd').

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite an existing scene when creating.

add_nodes.description: List of node definitions to add to an existing scene during edit_scene.

remove_nodes.description: List of node names to remove from an existing scene during edit_scene.

attach_script.description: Script attachment descriptor for edit_scene with 'node' and 'script_path'.

command.description: Arguments for running the Godot project (e.g., '--headless', or scene path).
